dedupe_keys.name: guizhou cement plant energy and carbon intensity

description: The Guizhou cement inventory research team publishes plant-level energy and carbon information for Portland cement production in southwest China. Seven Excel workbooks cover clinker and cement output, rotary kilns, emission factors, carbon dioxide emissions, energy intensity, fuel and electricity use, and solid-waste utilisation. The observations cover 2019–2022 and are freely available from Figshare under CC BY 4.0. These tables can calibrate industrial energy-demand and technology-transition simulations, including sectoral scenarios built with model-muse-os. A caveat is that plant accounting boundaries, fuel units and clinker-to-cement relationships must be reconciled before combining the workbooks. The regional sample should not be treated as representative of all Chinese cement production without further evidence. Individual plant values and workbook definitions were not inspected by downloading the files.
